stem.text: What describes the function of the atrioventricular node of the heart?

A.text: It causes the muscles of the atria to contract.

B.text: It delays the transmission of a wave of electrical activity from the sinoatrial node.

C.text: It initiates a new wave of electrical activity in the ventricles.

D.text: It provides a non-conducting barrier between the atria and the ventricles.
